$ go test ./b  # chain-b
    export/prices: One export of prices: import makes a script whose quote/ tree list shows.
        evaluate: Does what the case's evaluate/ tree says, from the stage it consumes.
        out/evaluate/outcome differs (-golden +got):
        - accepted
        + blocked import
        If the change is intended, run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... and read the diff before committing.
        out/evaluate/values.txt is recorded, and the cell is blocked: the lift import, on evaluate's path, has no committed outcome, out/import/outcome, which a normal run reads.
        Only the package that owns import runs it in a normal run, so this one can't tell whether import accepts the case now. Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./..., which reruns it, and delete nothing by hand before it has.
    export/prices: One export of prices: import makes a script whose quote/ tree list shows.
        list: Lists the files of the script's input view, with their bytes.

        - accepted
        + blocked import
        If the change is intended, run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... and read the diff before committing.
